view from the river with numbered landmarks; cleaner copy of the 1642 view

gaps: P0: nothing (#1 is a bishop portrait). P2 covered only by Merian’s copy of the 1642 view. P3: nothing with a reliable date.
notes: #10 Merian date: Topographia Galliae parts appeared 1655–1661; exact part year unknown, hence ‘about 1660’. #11 (Vue de Toulouse, Baugean after De Veze, Ostervald) skipped: museum dates it 1779–1830 and the caption names the Haute-Garonne department, so it is after 1790 and the 1779 date is wrong; it could fill P3 as ‘about 1815–20’ if the reviewer can date the Ostervald series. #17 (Garonne general view, 1890s) is a good alternative for P4 but the city is a thin strip. #6–8 show the Hôtel de la Vrillière (Hôtel de Toulouse) in Paris, not Toulouse. #2/#4/#5 (Thomas Aquinas procession, 1610) have only a generic town in the background. P6 is weak (window shot from a plane); a ground-level photo of the old town would be better if one can be found.
